title: ReText: Text Boosts Generalization in Image-Based Person Re-identification
abstract: arXiv:2602.05785v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generalizable image-based person re-identification (Re-ID) aims to recognize individuals across cameras in unseen domains without retraining. While visual features are sensitive to domain shifts, natural language descriptions remain consistent across domains, regardless of lighting changes and other biases. Since well-known multi-camera datasets lack textual descriptions, we update them with captions through a fine-tuned Vision-Language Model (VLM). We propose ReText, a novel method trained with textual supervision to enrich visual features with semantic cues. Besides, inspired by recent findings showing that incorporating single-camera data into training improves generalization, we also adopt this strategy. However, in contrast to such prior works, we exploit not only visual information but also the textual annotations naturally accompanying these samples. translated_abstract: 可泛化的基于图像的行人重识别（Re-ID）旨在无需重新训练的情况下，在未见过的域中跨摄像头识别个体。虽然视觉特征对域偏移很敏感，但自然语言描述在各域之间保持一致，不受光照变化及其他偏差的影响。由于知名的多摄像头数据集缺乏文本描述，我们通过微调的视觉-语言模型（VLM）为其生成描述文本进行更新。我们提出了ReText，这是一种通过文本监督训练的新颖方法，利用语义线索丰富视觉特征。此外，受近期研究发现的启发——将单摄像头数据纳入训练可以提高泛化能力，我们也采用了这一策略。然而，与此前的相关工作不同，我们不仅利用了视觉信息，还利用了这些样本自然附带的文本标注。最后，在训练过程中，ReText联合优化三个任务：(1) Re-（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出ReText方法，通过微调视觉-语言模型为多摄像头行人重识别数据集生成文本描述，并利用文本监督以及单摄像头数据的视觉与文本标注联合训练，以语义线索增强视觉特征，从而提升模型在未见域上的行人重识别泛化能力。
en_tdlr: ReText enriches visual features with semantic cues via textual supervision from VLM-generated captions and exploits both visual and textual annotations of single-camera data, boosting generalization in unseen-domain person re-identification.
